purpose: Shared dialog artwork for the Sango interface; original generated assets inspired by classic Three Kingdoms game UI craftsmanship.

assets.role: Transparent nine-slice border; raised ivory cloud scrolls, silver rims and grey-green jade inlay.
assets.layout: 280 source-pixel slices. Corners retain their aspect ratio; only the straight rails stretch. Do not stretch the complete bitmap to a rectangle.

assets.role: Quiet grey-blue ink and silk substrate; CSS glaze controls intensity and text contrast.

constraints: No official game pixels, characters, branding or lettering are included. UI text remains live HTML. These files ship with code and must be available offline.
